kind: Rust agent-host and coding-task control plane

runtime.execution: Tokio native host consumes separate pinned agent-runtime engine; owns SQLite task/chat workers, external CLI executors/daemon paths, scoped OS processes and web/MCP/REST surfaces.
runtime.service_boundary: Forge is governor of local tasks/worktrees/leases/domain state and runtime sessions; consumes providers/external CLIs. Shared independently governed computation is not the core ownership model.

summary: Rust local control plane with genuine persistent native chats, scoped actions, workflow task governance and source-preserving chat context graph; internal engine, task-context and audit/refit boundaries remain distinct.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: AgentSessionBackend.run_turn
actions.input: host session/scope/workspace, provider profile, input/history/system prompt, cancellation
actions.output: AgentTurnOutput text/usage/context manifest/pending interaction or typed error
actions.lifecycle: awaits runtime event completion and persistence; actual model/tool engine delegated to agent-runtime
actions.authority: persisted host-issued scope/identity/workspace, protected credential source

actions.authority: task-role scoped FsRead/FsWrite; task planner read only

actions.name: forge_task_command / forge_task_validate
actions.output: exit status, capped stdout/stderr, optional observation ID
actions.lifecycle: owned ephemeral process group/timeout; descendants killed on return/drop, no long-running service handle
actions.authority: worker/reviewer/verification scope; cleared env except PATH

actions.name: forge_scope_read / forge_scope_propose / forge_main_orchestration_read|propose / forge_project_orchestration_read|propose
actions.output: structured code/safe message/retry/permitted recovery, mutations or approval-required envelope
actions.lifecycle: awaited host command; task.adaptive yields persistent task identities
actions.authority: captured host identity/scope; allowed operation catalog/policy/version guards

actions.name: task.adaptive
actions.output: updated/created task IDs and structured outcome
actions.authority: model has bounded planning agency for bound project, no actor/scope overrides

actions.name: forge_create_task / forge_create_sub_tasks / forge_add_task_dependency / forge_reorder_sub_tasks / forge_transition_task / forge_cancel_task
actions.lifecycle: persisted task lifecycle, ready work picked up by dispatcher; root isolated vs serial children
actions.authority: MCP admitted context; transition actor recorded system:Mcp, not actual model identity

actions.name: WorkflowEngine.transition / move_task / workflow hook registry
actions.lifecycle: sequential hooks; dispatch gates and current workflow/version conflict detection
actions.authority: host workflow definitions and actor permissions; closed compiled action registry

actions.name: forge_send_agent_chat_message / cancel_turn / retry_turn
actions.lifecycle: queued leased job, bounded retry/cooldown, up to32 active; logical cancellation precedes backend termination

actions.name: forge_create_agent_handoff
actions.input: Main source chat,target project,bounded content/source revisions/dedupe
actions.output: provenance-linked handoff and target chat turn identity
actions.lifecycle: durable target admission; designated Main→Project path
actions.authority: current owner/Main binding and target project scope

actions.name: cancel / steer

actions.name: forge_memory_search / forge_memory_get
actions.lifecycle: SQL-backed layered context query through service
actions.authority: admitted project MCP scope; retrieved content is contextual data

filesystem.detail: Native model scoped read/list/write and Task workspaces are wired; paths/caps/roles constrain access. Inner external agents differ.

processes.detail: Native commands are bounded ephemeral process groups with15-minute deadline and cleared env; background descendants deliberately killed. Shell adapter has execution identities/cancel but return is not full reaping barrier.

code_actions.detail: Model can write source and call allowlisted program with args, enabling scripts/programs; no dedicated unrestricted executable composition/kernel action traced.

persistent_kernel.detail: No persistent shared computational kernel established in native tool composition, task executors, LCM or chat workers.

standing_database.detail: Forge owns SQLite domain/context/memory state and exposes layered search; this is application storage, not general independently governed standing DB access.

workflow_programming.detail: State graph JSON, role config, sequential guards/hooks and cascades control task execution; actions resolved from closed compiled host registry. Model task.adaptive changes plan topology under policy.

multi_model.detail: Separate native/provider/CLI profiles and role/chat/execution instances actually run independently selected models, not just one provider selector.

live_collaboration.detail: Persistent Main/Project chats and explicit provenance-linked Main→Project handoffs plus task outcomes supply cooperation; not general IRC peer room. CLI chat does not expose steer/persistent native checkpoint/LCM.

concurrent_work.detail: Up to32 leased chat jobs in JoinSet, role capacity checks and separate task execution identities; active native generation prohibits simultaneous turns in one runtime session.

steering_interrupt.detail: Native active-session steering/interrupt is real. Backend run cancellation can await shutdown, but public cancel/job cancellation and shell cancel do not return proof of all provider/process cessation.

turn_redefinition.detail: Host RuntimeBuilder composes per-turn tool catalog/system prompt/model/compaction/security/broker; model domain operations alter task plans, not inner compiled model-loop program.

compaction.detail: Chat LCM is wired with SQLite original/summary graph and deterministic excerpts; Task uses structural compaction without LCM and reviewers/inquiries are self-contained. Dependency owns coordinator algorithm.

context_repair.detail: Authorized paginated expansion returns retained original leaf entries/child nodes with source cursor validation. Native model-facing rehydration/repair commands are in engine dependency/untraced; task structural history differs.

original_audit.detail: LCM leaves retain source entries but explicit tail truncation can delete unprotected history. Visible logs omit/redact raw tool data, silently ignore callback write errors and stop after10MiB; not core everything audit.

audit_query.detail: Per-execution sequence pagination, domain/chat IDs and memory/context queries exist; malformed lines skipped and capped semantic logs are not unified immutable original audit.

hot_change.detail: Frozen chat admission protects automatic retry config; explicit retry re-admits new profile. Dispatcher loads current project workflow and transitions can reject stale authority. No general defer-until-affected-work-completes hot activation.

rebuild_continuity.detail: No executable rebuild/outpost/reinhabitation protocol established in inspected runtime, persistent sessions, graceful shutdown and recovery; persistent task/session retry alone is not refit.

remote_services.detail: External CLI/daemon executors and provider HTTP are consumed, but Forge owns local control plane, worktrees, leases, task governance and context DB; external fabric consumer boundary differs from Arconaut.

self_improvement.detail: Model adaptive split/sequence/replace and file/command work support development under scoped policy. No model-governed experiment/activation/rollback/autodroit runtime traced.

complaints.detail: No everywhere model complaint capturing complete agent state into external issue table established in inspected task worklog/domain/action/sink paths; task errors/outcomes are narrower.

authority.detail: Host binds identity/scope/workspace and role permissions, allowlists commands, controls structured mutations/approval and rejects model authority overrides. MCP transition attributes system:Mcp due to absent agent execution identity.

evaluation.detail: Source-read tests attack real SQLite source expansion/CAS and real Unix process-group liveness, plus deterministic retry-input and stale workflow mutation invariants; not executed here.

time_order.detail: DB chat sequence/job leases/version/source/causation and LCM revisions provide ordering; JSONL per-writer sequence/UTC time capped/skippable and not universal durable causal audit.

evidence.claim: Forge describes a local control plane for persistent assistants, isolated coding tasks, serial shared-worktree children and CI/review delivery gates.
README explicitly marks Main/Project Agent Chat replacement model as being implemented; broad feature claims require wiring checks.
Rust workspace includes agent-host, executors/services; native engine is separate pinned git agent-runtime dependency ca6c17e, not inline source.
Native provider construction resolves protected credential source and selects concrete runtime provider implementation; dependency owns request encoding/inner loop.
run_turn verifies persisted scope/workspace binding and composes scoped tools; result observer retains per-call structured summaries.
RuntimeBuilder installs model limits/provider/workspace/broker, persistent stores and scope-specific LCM/structural compaction, system prompt and reasoning, then starts session.

Active generation prevents concurrent turn per runtime session; send starts turn, events forward selected deltas/tools, cancellation branch awaits shutdown, completion/persistence precedes registry finish.
Return reconstructs latest assistant text, context-manifest link and per-attempt usage; failures/cancel retain usage reports but do not return successful output.
cancel merely requests interrupt_current_turn and steer calls steer_current_turn on active session; methods do not await caller-independent quiescence.
Dropping active backend future requests session cancel and spawns shutdown/registry cleanup; cleanup is asynchronous, not drop-time quiescence.
Chat uses LCM/persistent session; Task worker/planner use persistent structurally compacted history without LCM; reviewer/inquiry limits differ. Retry-aware input avoids duplicate unanswered input.
Task role and allowed permissions determine actual read/list/write/command/validate/web tools; planner lacks writes/processes.
forge_task_read prepare/invoke revalidate scoped path and return at most128KiB lossy UTF8 with truncation flag.
forge_task_write scopes path, caps content1MiB and writes after second path check.
forge_task_command accepts allowlisted program/args; prepare requests ProcessSpawn, invocation returns exit/output and optional persisted command-observation ID.
Command runs with cleared env except PATH,15-minute timeout, capped drained stdout/stderr and own process group killed on completion/drop; child wait/status drives completion.
Unix ProcessGroupGuard drop sends SIGKILL ignoring error; mechanism kills group but does not synchronously reap every descendant.
Scoped proposal checks allowed operation, dedupe/correlation and rejects model authority overrides; invoke passes captured identity/scope/session to host provider.
task.adaptive is wired to policy-checked TaskService split/sequence/replace with expected task/board versions and rationale, server-derived actor and idempotency.
Forge provider returns structured success/failure/approval requirements; payload validation gives correct-input retry instructions.
Chat send guards content and admits durable message+turn job with source/correlation; server resolves responder/profile/policy and allocates message sequence.
Chat cancellation uses expected job version and idempotency in DB transaction; not direct provider cancellation in this method.
Explicit terminal retry keeps trigger message but re-resolves new authority; differs from automatic retries preserving frozen admission.
Main→Project handoff validates current bindings/target, guards bounded content and captures source revisions/causation for admitted target turn.
Chat worker claims DB jobs into JoinSet up to32 active, cancellation on shutdown joins all tasks; claim uses immediate transaction and provider cooldown gating.
Automatic retry uses same frozen responder/profile/policy and validates authority/provider availability before durable usage admission.
Owner heartbeat renews leased job/version; zero-row/error cancels turn.
Main and Project chat native turns resolve separate profile/model/session/credential and scratch/verification workspace, command allowlist then backend.run_turn.
CLI chat backend reports no native persistent checkpoints/LCM/steer; creates per-job sandbox, runs adapter and invokes cancel on token cancellation.
Task execution validates provider-call admission, applies project command allowlist and issues host-scoped native turn using frozen execution provider/model config.
Dispatcher skips paused projects, resolves current workflow and recovers in-flight work before starting ready tasks.
Workflow definitions deserialize JSON with default fallback; root and child/actor distinctions resolve different workflow programs.
Transitions enforce declared edges/system actors, user override rules and optional expected project workflow/version, then load merged state config.
Before-exit hook actions actually execute sequentially, refresh task state and block transition on configured guard failure.
Workflow actions are closed host registry including run_ci_steps/run_merge/dispatch_role_agent/dependency_gate/retry/cleanup cascades; unknown action errors.
Role dispatch checks agent pause/capacity and current reviewer/workflow authority before admission; inner launch continuation beyond excerpt not independently audited.
LCM append authorizes view, validates timeline/fingerprint/idempotency and current revision/tail sequence before DB commit.
LCM leaf commit immediate transaction checks CAS, exact original entry sequence and overlap, inserts summary node/operation without deleting original entries.
LCM expansion authorizes view, bounds page size and verifies node/source fingerprint cursor, returning original leaf entries or child nodes.
Condensation validates active child IDs/order/source fingerprint/classification, refuses secret sources and checks revision metadata.
LCM truncation refuses ranges intersecting any summary node but deletes unprotected tail entries; store is not universally immutable originals.
Wired deterministic summary model reduces text to bounded per-message excerpts; not semantic model summarization or repair of lost task structural history.
Turn sink records selected readable deltas and credential-masked tool previews/summaries; write errors ignored at event callbacks.
JSONL per-writer sequence, flush but no fsync, output cap then truncation/no further entries; existing-file sequence resumes but byte count resets at construction.
Log reader paginates from sequence, skips malformed lines and advances cursor from last retained record.
Exposed MCP dispatch includes tasks/dependencies/memory/agents/projects/chat/handoff APIs with representative handlers traced.
forge_create_task validates project/title/parent and calls create_task_with_dependencies, returning task API data after service mutation.
forge_memory_search enforces admitted project context and returns layered retrieved context/cursor, not general DB kernel.
MCP cancellation/queries/updates/transitions call service/DB; transition explicitly attributes caller as system:Mcp because agent execution identity is unavailable.
Graceful shutdown stops admission, cancels active executors then records recovery/auto-resume; cancellation errors warn and recovery write failure defaults away.
Shell adapter sends TERM/grace and KILL group, starts direct child kill if needed then returns without final await/reaping barrier.
Lease expiry records prior started/pending provider invocation as unreplayable coverage gap; not replay of the prior provider result.

tests.oracle: In-memory SQLite migration+real store append/leaf assert revision/replay/content/expansion count and foreign-view rejection. Reopened adapter shares same in-memory DB, not OS crash/disk durability; stale runtime revision string hardcoded.

tests.focus: Stale project workflow authority at transition boundary
tests.oracle: Real SQLite fixture changes project workflow before transition; expects VersionConflict and unchanged task/status/version, no transition log or running execution. Does not test all changed-running-work activation semantics.

tests.focus: Bounded command descendant termination on normal exit/timeout/dropped future
tests.oracle: Unix shell spawns background child and oracle probes PID existence with kill(signal None), asserts capped command exit/error and eventual child gone; real OS process invariant for that group, not provider/network quiescence.

tests.focus: Retry after unanswered model tool round and answered duplicate input
tests.oracle: Artificial Message arrays assert continuation substituted only for unanswered matching user input; no external-effect replay guarantee.

strengths: Host-issued scope/tool composition and version checks separate model proposal input from identity authority.
Chat LCM preserves original entries behind summary nodes and validates paged expansion sources.
Real process-group liveness and stale SQLite workflow tests attack direct fault classes.
limits: Native model request encoding/inner tool iteration/LCM coordinator live in separate git dependency, not independently traced here.
Task structural context compaction is distinct from chat LCM; CLI chat capabilities narrower.
Turn callback log failures ignored; previews/redaction/caps and explicit LCM truncation preclude full original audit.
MCP mutation attribution can be system identity rather than invoking model; cancellation request and cessation differ.
arconaut_questions: Can original-source expansion become a first-class model repair operation across all task/chat modes?
Which immutable original ledger should survive capped/redacted displays and tail truncation?
How can a consumer harness use this orchestration fabric without inheriting its worktree/service governance?
What version/defer boundary preserves model agency while preventing changed programs from activating mid-work?
